summary: Review workers, queues and scheduled jobs for idempotency, retries, ordering, poison messages and tenant or context propagation.

must_inspect.why: At-least-once delivery requires effects that can tolerate duplicate execution.
false_positive_guards: Not every job needs global idempotency if upstream delivery is exactly-once and proven.

must_inspect.why: Retries should distinguish transient failure from permanent poison messages.
false_positive_guards: A bounded retry without a dead-letter queue may be acceptable for low-value ephemeral tasks.

must_inspect.why: Tenant, auth and correlation context can be lost across queue boundaries.
false_positive_guards: Do not assume request identity should propagate when the job intentionally uses service authority.
A retry loop is not necessarily a reliability bug without an unbounded failure path.
handoff_triggers: Incident or release ops -> customer-ops or release-readiness
